name: Asaba Kamine
source: Older sister of Kazuharu. In comparison to Kazuharu she is consider to be a prodigy being smart, athletic, and popular. Worried about her brother becoming a hetare she gives him an ultimatum to make a girlfriend  before end of school festival or suffer her wraith.
